title: Interplanetary Invoice
tagline: Decentralised Invoice Publisher & Payment App for freelancer & by freelancers
description: This project aims decentralised Invoice Payment Platform that could help Freelancers ask & get payment from and to another. Used and Powered by Freelancers. I interested to build DAO for freelancers, so this app could be owned by the DAO and provides benefits for the DAO members that are freelancers but not limited into.
how_its_made: The project will be using IPFS to send and deliver the invoice, backed by Ceramics for the Data Soverign authentications (self.id) & schemas. and by help of Covalent to check the blockchains transactions. for a start it will support Ethereum & Polygon , but in the future it should be chain agnostic app to be comply with multichain.
